narr: Slow moving thunderstorms developed across eastern GA and pushed into central SC during the afternoon and evening hours of May 29th. These produced flash flooding north of Augusta and thunderstorm wind damage in the Midlands of SC.
ev: Columbia County EM reported water rising in the yard of a residence approaching the home.
Social media report with video showing swiftly flowing water from overflowing Uchee Creek onto Barnsley Dr flooding the road with trash bins floating down the street and causing property damage.

Social media report with video showing significant flooding of property in back yard of residence from Mt Enna Branch out of its banks. Swiftly moving water level was up to the jumping surface of a trampoline (around 4 ft).
Multiple social media reports of significant water flowing across Furys Ferry Rd from Jones Creek out of its banks. Reports of water 2-3 ft high at the headlights of cars driving through the water.
Columbia County EM reported water over the road on Furys Ferry Rd near Southern Pines Drive at Jones Creek.
